name: Deduction Classifier Agent
fn: Classifies trade vs non-trade, assigns reason codes, maps to GL
detail: Classifies each deduction as contract (GPO fee, rebate, distributor, demo) or operational (shortage, pricing, warranty, freight, SLA), assigns the reason code and maps the GL account. Codes deductions consistently for downstream automation.
sap: SAP FSCM-DM · SD-TPM / Vistex programmes · FI-AR credit memo (FB75) · CO write-off postings
